description: PROD-derived first-step inputs of chained validations, read-only. Each source names where its real PROD events live, the exact read method, how source_events.py turns them into the first mapping's input language (declarative expressions, no mapping-specific code), which rows are quarantined and why, and which fields are sensitive. A source with no PROD producer of the input language is normalized here from the provider's own events; the normalization rules are data, versioned with this catalog, and every quarantine reason is counted.

quiq-lifecycle.meaning: Quiq SMS lifecycle observations as the quiq language (lexicon src/data/quiq.json, dataset lifecycle) that quiq-to-lexicon reads. No PROD system emits this language: sms-workflow consumes the raw Quiq BI exports (sender/src/lambdas/process-quiq-events.ts) and writes graph facts and Interprose files instead, so the lifecycle rows are normalized from the raw events plus the send context sms-workflow stored when it sent each message.

producerEvidence.rawEvents: Quiq delivers BI exports to the PROD bucket so-quiq-events under quiq-inbound/bi-data/springoakscapital/<UTC day>/<EventType>-<id>.json (verified read-only 2026-10-01: 2026-09-30 holds NotificationsDeliverabilityStatus 1433, CustomerOptOutStatusChanged 2635, ConversationClosed 364 and other conversation/agent families)
producerEvidence.sendContext: sms-workflow SendContextTable (PROD DynamoDB KadabraSendLifecycleStack-SendContextTable*, hash key providerMessageId, TTL attribute ttl enabled): debtId, phoneNumber, interactionIdentifier, templateIdentifier, messageId, batchId, sentAt per accepted send (docs/contracts/send-lifecycle.md 'Send Context')
producerEvidence.processedBatches: sms-workflow lifecycle artifact bucket kadabrasendlifecyclestack-lifecycleartifactbucket4-miqsjse65y6b, sms-lifecycle/processed-batches/<YYYY/MM/DD of sentAt>/<batchId>.json: batch.items[] (message_id, rendered_message_s3_uri) and results[] (messageId, providerMessageId)
producerEvidence.renderedBodies: the exact rendered_message_s3_uri object of each send (Jigglypuff text artifact, text/plain)
producerEvidence.earlierRun: the DEV evidence s3://transformpipelinestack-databuckete3889a50-rmklq0v3to8q/test/sms-mapping/quiq/2026-09-19/run-20260923T133500Z/ (130,892 observations: 130,321 accepted, 501 missing_debt, 70 missing_send_context) was produced by a one-off script with exactly this bridge (providerMessageId -> results.messageId -> batch.items.message_id -> interaction_identifier), the same phone-location policy and template_is_known false; lexicon PRs #782 and #788 carry the language and mappings, not the producer

listing.detail: list the window day's folder and the next day's (late exports of the window's events), read only objects of the declared families, keep observations whose effective_at lies in the half-open UTC window

readMethod.aws: aws s3api list-objects-v2 / s3 cp (download only), dynamodb list-tables / batch-get-item (read-only) with the operator's PROD profile; silvally_io refuses every PROD write verb
readMethod.boundedBy: one window day plus one spill day of listed objects; send-context reads only for the window's provider ids (100 per batch-get-item); processed batches and rendered bodies only for resolved sends; the canary resolves observations in deterministic order until it has 10 accepted rows (at most --canary-scan-limit)

quarantine.detail: no SendContext row for the provider id (never sent through sms-workflow, or expired by its TTL)
opt events carry no debt reference and have no SendContext; on 2026-09-19 all 501 were quarantined this way

excludedFamilies.ConversationClosed: conversation transcript, not a delivery lifecycle observation; its outbound messages are already observed through NotificationsDeliverabilityStatus (on 2026-09-19 every one was quarantined missing_send_context)
excludedFamilies.ConversationActivated: conversation routing event, not an SMS lifecycle observation
excludedFamilies.ConversationDeniedAsSpam: conversation routing event, not an SMS lifecycle observation
excludedFamilies.ConversationEnqueued: conversation routing event, not an SMS lifecycle observation
excludedFamilies.ConversationInactivated: conversation routing event, not an SMS lifecycle observation
excludedFamilies.ConversationMergedAsDangling: conversation routing event, not an SMS lifecycle observation
excludedFamilies.ConversationOwnerChanged: conversation routing event, not an SMS lifecycle observation
excludedFamilies.ConversationRequested: conversation routing event, not an SMS lifecycle observation
excludedFamilies.AgentSessionMetrics: agent metric, not an SMS lifecycle observation
excludedFamilies.AgentStatusChanged: agent status, not an SMS lifecycle observation

renderedArtifact.detail: the object is copied byte-for-byte into the DEV package (artifacts/<sha256 of the source URI>/<basename>) and artifact_uri names that DEV copy, so DEV Transform and the DEV Persist export hydrate from DEV; the SHA-256 is computed from the bytes

phoneLocation.read: iceberg_snapshot_read.py --profile <prod-profile> --table graph_call_outputs.phone_number --columns phone_number,location_type,updated_at --key-column phone_number --keys-file <private>/lookup-keys/phoneLocation.txt --current-state-as-of <now> --data-max-column updated_at --private-dir <private>/phone-location (a key-bounded current-state read of the window's phones; rows stay private)
phoneLocation.detail: the approved policy of the earlier run: agreeing valid values collapse, conflicting valid values become MOBILE, a valid value beats an invalid one, no valid value or no row becomes MOBILE

normalizationNotes: template_is_known is always false: SendContext carries templateIdentifier but not the governed template metadata (name, family, content URI and commit, language) the quiq language requires when true. Every resulting sms_log row has an empty txt_msg_template_id; source_events.py expect counts rows whose SendContext names a template as templateMetadataUnresolved (a coverage gap reported per run, not a mismatch).
observed_at equals effective_at: the BI export records one time per update.

daySelection.rule: the most recent complete UTC day whose folder holds objects of every family in requiredFamilies, within a 14-day lookback
daySelection.command: source_events.py days --catalog reference/chain-sources.json --source quiq-lifecycle --profile <prod-profile> --lookback-days 14 --out source-days.json (object counts per UTC day and family; --slice-days and --input-days input of source_window.py data-days)

sensitiveFields.decision: ownerDecisions.sensitiveFieldStaging = stage-real-values-to-dev; without it source_events.py build stops with SensitiveStagingDecisionRequired before any PROD read
